services.name: School Tours
services.desc: Our educational experiences for Pre‑K to 12th grade students use authentic works of art to inspire and encourage critical thinking and to make real-world connections. Free School Tours at the Portland Museum of Art invite students to utilize their critical thinking skills and personal experiences to slow down, carefully investigate, and develop their own interpretations of works of art. Free School Tours are led by highly trained Museum Educators, who have diverse experiences working with students of all ages and abilities. These tours do not require any previous knowledge or experience in the visual arts, and are crafted to meet the needs of your students and connect to your curricula. Any
